title: 2011 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 Carbon Special Edition

sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2011 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 Carbon Special Edition, finished in Supersonic Blue Metallic with an Ebony interior. This Corvette is equipped with a 6-speed manual transmission, and the odometer currently displays approximately 8,500 miles. This Chevrolet is offered with a clean Carfax vehicle history report and has reportedly been registered to one owner in Florida since 2012. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, this Corvette is a Z06 Carbon Special Edition model, and notable factory equipment includes the Z06 Carbon Special Edition Package, the 3LZ Premium Equipment Group, a limited-slip rear differential, a dual-mode exhaust system, leather and suede upholstery with blue stitching, a head-up display, and cruise control. Notable modifications reported by the seller are limited to a "Corvette" windshield banner and "Stingray" letters on the rear bumper. Released for 2005, the sixth-generation Corvette kept its predecessor's proportions but featured an updated exterior design with exposed headlights returning to the range for the first time since 1962. In 2006, the high-performance Z06 variant was added to the range, and it was celebrated as the fastest and most powerful street-legal car ever released by General Motors. It gained a mammoth V8 with titanium connecting rods, aluminum and carbon fiber components to keep weight in check, and a wider track. The C6 Z06 would be the last naturally aspirated iteration of the Z06 until the C8 was introduced. General Motors' goal was to produce 500 examples of the Z06 Carbon Special Edition to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the Corvette's first entry in the 24 Hours of Le Mans race. GM fell short of that number, and only 252 examples were produced. Power comes from a 7.0-liter LS7 V8, rated at about 505 horsepower and 470 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual transmission.
